From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@cloudwave.com>

Cc: marketplace-ops@cloudwave.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace resale addendum — fee attribution & audit scope

Irene — thanks again for the demo last week. Attaching a draft of the resale/addendum CloudWave legal sent over. We need to close pass-through billing language and agree an audit/evidence scope before the order form goes live. Key asks from our side: 

- Confirm that marketplace fees (platform fee + tax) are passed through to reseller billing with a single line on the invoice (they want clarity for downstream reporting).
- Define "audit evidence" — what logs and traces Redwood can provide on usage and invoice mapping.
- A short escalation SLA if inconsistencies are found (we propose 10 business days to reconcile).

Can you loop in legal and ops on your side? I tagged Marketplace Ops on our side for technical evidencing. Attached: CloudWave_Resale_Addendum_v1.pdf.

Thanks — Alice

Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace resale addendum — fee attribution & audit scope

Thanks Alice — forwarding to legal/partner-ops to triage. Internal note below (Ben/Karthik/Marissa): can you run a redline pass and confirm operational evidence we can commit to by next Wednesday? High level items we need to agree back to CloudWave: 

- Clear pass-through language in Order Form / Addendum: how fees show on Redwood invoices and whether CloudWave requires a separate invoice for platform cut.
- Audit rights: logs, token-level metering, invoice mapping, sample export format (CSV/Parquet).
- Data retention window for metering and the process for evidence requests (turnaround SLA).
- Fallbacks if we cannot produce an itemized mapping for legacy customers for a given billing period.

Action items for internal owners: 
- Ben: legal redlines + suggested clause language for indemnity carveouts and audit boundaries.
- Karthik: ops/infra feasibility — what metering attributes we can guarantee (model id, timestamp, customer_id, route) and retention durations. 
- Marissa: commercial/ordering — confirm whether the order form needs a separate charge line or if the pass-through can be reflected as a revenue allocation note.

Alice: we aim to have a redline and an evidence checklist by EOD Wed (2027-06-16). If that timeline doesn't work, let me know. Forwarding CloudWave draft attached.

Irene Choi

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Wong <alice.wong@cloudwave.com>, marketplace-ops@cloudwave.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace resale addendum — fee attribution & audit scope

Irene / team — quick redline summary and operational asks (see attached redline doc for inline language): resale_addendum_redlines_benc.docx.

Legal summary (high level):
- Pass-through clause: propose these elements: (1) Redwood will display the platform fee and applicable taxes as a single line item labeled "Marketplace Platform Fee (passed through)" on the reseller invoice; (2) Redwood will provide a monthly allocation report that maps reseller invoice lines to underlying customer usage records.
- Audit rights: limit to one (1) audit request per 12-month period unless material discrepancy is found; Redwood will provide up to 30 days of historical metering extracts for the disputed invoice period; requests beyond that require mutual agreement and reasonable costs allocation.
- Indemnity and liability carveouts: we should push back on broad customer-facing indemnities tied to third-party reseller contracts — propose scoped indemnity limited to Redwood's direct acts/omissions.
- Escalation SLA: 10 business days for initial reconciliation response, 30 calendar days to close or propose remediation.

Specific clause language (to paste into redlines):
"Redwood will, upon request, provide to Reseller a usage export for the billing period in CSV format containing: timestamp (UTC), model_identifier, route_identifier, reseller_customer_id, token_count, and invoice_line_id. Redwood retains metering data for 18 months. Audit requests shall be limited to one per 12-month period. Additional requests or forensic analysis may incur reasonable costs which will be mutually agreed in writing."

Ops asks to Karthik (need quick confirmation):
- Can we guarantee retention of metering attributes for 18 months? If not, propose 12 months with an ops-offer to run archival extracts on request (subject to fees/time).
- Can we export invoice_line_id mapping to the token-level metering?
- Any known technical blockers for mapping marketplace platform fee to downstream reseller invoices for nested resellers?

Attachments: resale_addendum_redlines_benc.docx; audit-evidence-checklist.xlsx (draft)

Ben Carter
Senior Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Wong <alice.wong@cloudwave.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace resale addendum — fee attribution & audit scope

Thanks Ben — quick ops confirmation and rollout notes. Summary of feasibility after engineering sync: 

- Retention: we can guarantee token- and request-level metering for 12 months in the primary hot store. We can produce 18-month extracts from cold archival within 5 business days (we should note potential cost/time).
- Invoice mapping: we can output invoice_line_id and the mapping to token-level records for all orders created after the marketplace integration cutoff date (we need to record a versioning field for legacy orders). For legacy orders prior to integration, we should mark as "best-effort" and include a fallback reconciliation process (sample-based).
- Export format: ops can produce CSV or parquet exports containing: utc_timestamp, model_id, route, reseller_customer_id, token_count, invoice_line_id, request_id. Example export template attached (audit-evidence-checklist.xlsx).
- SLA: 10 business days to first response is fine. For full forensic exports (complete invoice trace) we propose 30 calendar days; if CloudWave requests ad-hoc historical pulls beyond 12 months, we will coordinate costs.

Implementation items for partner launch: 
- Add a clause to Order Form acknowledging the integration cutoff date and that older orders are reconciled on a best-effort basis.
- Add a footnote to invoices: "Marketplace Platform Fee shown is allocated per reseller terms; detailed allocation reports available upon request with a standard reconciliation SLA."
- Ops owner: Karthik Iyer (will coordinate with Billing Eng and Data Team).
- Delivery: ops will deliver a sample export and a compact runbook for CloudWave by 2027-06-20.

Marissa/Ben/Irene: if legal is happy with Ben's proposed clause text, I can prep the runbook and sample export. Alice — happy to sync with your marketplace ops on a technical 30-min call next week to demo the export format.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
